meta_title: Steven Heane Plumbing & Heating | Plumber Leicester
meta_description: Steven Heane Plumbing & Heating offers reliable plumbing and heating services across Leicester. Local expert, free quotes, fast response. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Local Plumber & Heating Engineer — Leicester
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, and heating problems fixed fast by a trusted Leicester tradesman — no fuss, no hidden fees.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full boiler installations, Steven Heane covers every plumbing and heating need for Leicester homeowners.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Upgrade to an energy-efficient boiler installed to manufacturer standards. We help you choose the right model for your home and budget, with minimal disruption to your day.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with an annual service or a prompt repair when things go wrong. Faults diagnosed quickly to restore your heating and hot water fast.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Full central heating installations, system upgrades, and power flushing to remove sludge and restore radiator performance throughout your Leicester home.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or loss of hot water — we respond swiftly to urgent plumbing emergencies across Leicester to prevent costly damage to your property.

services.title: Bathroom & Shower Fitting
services.desc: From replacing a tired shower to fitting a brand-new bathroom suite, we handle all plumbing connections neatly and professionally for a finish you'll love.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Persistent drips or hidden leaks can cause serious damage if left unchecked. We locate the source accurately and carry out lasting repairs to give you complete peace of mind.

about_pullquote: I take pride in every job — your home deserves the same care as my own.
about_para_1: Steven Heane Plumbing & Heating is a Leicester-based business built on reliability, honest pricing, and quality workmanship. Operating from Radford Drive, Steven has spent over a decade serving homeowners across the city and surrounding areas, building a reputation as the go-to local plumber people genuinely trust.
about_para_2: Unlike larger contractors, you deal directly with Steven on every job — there are no subcontractors and no surprises on the final invoice. Customers return time and again because they know the work will be done properly, on time, and at a price that's fair.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Steven Heane

reviews.text: Steven came out the same day my boiler packed in and had it sorted within a couple of hours. Really friendly, tidy worker and the price was very reasonable. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend him to anyone in Leicester.
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Had a leak under the kitchen sink that two other plumbers had failed to fix properly. Steven found the actual cause straight away and repaired it first time. Brilliant service, very professional and kept me informed throughout.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Booked Steven for a full boiler service and he was punctual, thorough and explained everything clearly. Great to have a local tradesman you can actually rely on. Will definitely be using him again.
reviews.author: Diane M.
